rca_of_issue: BUG-306 RCA: The preprod backend endpoint /api/v2/vendoremployee/aggregator-config is unreachable (ERR_NETWORK — axios error.code='ERR_NETWORK', no response object). The fix in AggregatorSetupView.jsx line 37 checks err?.response?.status === 404, which is false when there is no response at all. The axios interceptor in axios.js sets err.readableMessage = 'Cannot reach server. Check your internet connection.' for ERR_NETWORK errors. The else branch then calls setError() which shows the red banner. Fix: expand the 404 check to also cover !err.response (network-level failure).
